title: Version 1.22.0
body:
Version 1.22.0

July 11th, 2023

Added:

  • Added the fastest car in the game, The Oak mobile! Can be purchased at the lighthouse
  • Added the Refined Saw

Changes:

  • Elevators can now change their speed
  • Removed fireworks from the Oak Depot
  • Revamped Saw combining
  • Revamped Sander combining
  • Healing coil now heals at 5hp/s (3hp/s prior)

Bug Fixes:

  • WMI Vinyl was fixed, and will be automatically put into gramophones!
  • Fixed issue with Garage Doors being replicatable with BuildMode
